_note: Our own data (DESIGN.md section 11: no solution menus). How a reply's tone lands: temper (0 calm .. 10, kept per NPC across visits, cools by 1 each day) and patience (per conversation; at 0 they end it). An explicit 'tone' on a choice wins; otherwise the choice's tags map to a tone. When temper reaches 'draws_at', someone who carries a weapon draws and the fight starts in town, on foot (Core p.45: switching to mech combat); others throw you out. Walking away ('leave') ends the scene calmly.

warn: Their hand drifts toward the gun at their hip.
Their eyes go flat. One more word like that.
Somebody behind you pushes their chair back.
patience_out: "I've said all I'm going to say."
They turn their back on you.
draws: Steel clears leather. Everyone in the street scatters.
thrown_out: "Out. Now. And don't come back until you've learned some manners."
They call for help, and you're shown the door.
cold: "I've got nothing to say to you."
They won't even look at you.
